$comment: START HERE. One machine-readable handoff per reserved Lovable reference delivery (Director #365 5821646487). The delivering author fills it and commits it beside the existing evidence manifests (review-evidence.json / recovery-truth-1.json / motion-feel-1.json style). One file feeds human review, the Journey parity register and Claude reads; history is not recreated in prompts. Fields marked required are required; unknown values are written as null with a reason, never guessed.

startHere.journey: REQUIRED — one line: who is doing what, from where to where
readFirst: REQUIRED — the 1–3 source files a reader opens first
doNotPort: REQUIRED — demo-only mechanisms that must never reach the canonical app (simulated ledger, reviewer tools, sample identities, demo timing)

revisions.acceptedProductSourceSha: REQUIRED — the exact Lovable product revision the Director accepted (null + reason while still a draft)
revisions.workingDraftSha: REQUIRED — the current working head if it differs from the accepted revision (never a reference)

fixture.entry: REQUIRED — the exact entry state (route / tab / overlay / scroll / focus) and how it is seeded

expectedStates.name: REQUIRED
expectedStates.expect: what is on screen, in the reference's own words

sourceMap.component: REQUIRED — the reference component or pure function
sourceMap.sha256: REQUIRED — as recorded in the delivery manifest
sourceMap.classification: REQUIRED — one of REUSE | NATIVE ADAPTATION | DEMO ONLY
sourceMap.canonicalCounterpart: the Expo / Firebase file or contract it maps to, or null + reason

motion.name: REQUIRED per motion — e.g. MOVE sheet open
motion.easing: the curve, by name or cubic-bezier
motion.interruption: what happens if the user acts mid-motion
motion.measured: real recording / trace link, or null + reason

screenshots.note: default entry frame vs scrolled state must be stated

recordings.coversInteraction: tap / focus / navigation actually performed, not simulated

measuredLimitations: REQUIRED — e.g. not a real-device test; no keyboard validation; 390x420 clips Back/Review

canonical.sha: the canonical candidate / integrated SHA, or null while none exists

intentionalDifferences.why: platform | data truth | accepted contract | seam
intentionalDifferences.rulingRef: the #365 / PR comment id that approved it, or null

feedbackLoop.toLovable: after a canonical candidate exists: the bounded packet sent back (matching synthetic frames / recording, relevant code, accepted platform differences) and the question asked (the three most consequential UX mismatches with concrete evidence), or null

findings.directorDisposition: accepted | rejected | deferred, with the comment id
